title: The listed condensed coefficient maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$. Use the commutative condensed rings of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], the finite extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and valuation rings $\mathcal O_E$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and the filtered-colimit condensed algebraic closure of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. In the bundled category of commutative condensed coefficient rings of [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces], define a listed coefficient map to be a finite composite of: (i) any unital homomorphism $A\to B$ of finite commutative discrete rings each killed by a power of $\ell$; (ii) $\mathcal O_E\to\mathcal O_F$, the integral inclusion of [det-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients-finite-free]; (iii) $E\to F$ [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-map], for finite subextensions $E\subseteq F\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with the condensed rings $\underline{\mathcal O}_E$ [def-sfb-padic-integers-condensed-ring] and $\underline E$ [def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring]; (iv) $\mathcal O_E\to E$ [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield-point]; (v) $E\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ [def-sfb-qlbar-subextension-to-qlbar]; (vi) any continuous homomorphism $\mathcal O_E\to A$ with $A$ finite discrete and killed by a power of $\ell$. The maps are postcomposition on continuous sections, with the integral inclusion as in [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]. Empty composites are identities at these coefficient endpoints. The zero ring and nonflat maps are included.
